title_en: The Self-Improving Company: Why AI Will Break the Roman Legion Model of Business
dek_en: A talk argues companies are still built like Roman legions — hierarchies where information flows up and orders flow down through people. AI breaks that model: rather than bolting on copilots, companies should redesign themselves as AI-native systems built around recursive self-improving loops.
title_zh: 自我进化的公司：AI 如何改写组织的底层逻辑
dek_zh: 演讲指出传统公司像"罗马军团"一样依靠层级运作。AI 正在打破这种模式——与其把 AI 当作"副驾驶"，不如把公司重新设计成围绕"递归自我改进循环"构建的 AI 原生系统。
